deletion.entryMessage: You can permanently delete your account and personal data.
deletion.title: Delete my account
deletion.now: Right away: your account is closed, every device is signed out, notifications stop, your RSVPs for matches that have not started become "not coming" and your pending call applications are withdrawn.
deletion.grace: If you sign in again within {{days}} days, the deletion is cancelled and your account reopens. RSVPs set to "not coming" are not restored.
deletion.after: After {{days}} days your name, email, photo and other personal data are deleted permanently. Played matches show "Deleted user" in your place.
deletion.teams: Teams where you are the only member are deleted. In other teams you captain, captaincy passes to the longest-serving co-captain, otherwise to the longest-serving member.
deletion.subscription: If you have Kadro Pro, cancel it separately in the App Store or Google Play.
deletion.continueQuestion: You will need to confirm your identity to delete your account. Do you want to continue?
deletion.passwordHint: Enter your password again to delete your account.
deletion.appleHint: You will confirm your identity with Apple to delete your account.
deletion.webOnly: We cannot confirm your identity on this device. Delete your account on the account deletion page of the website.
deletion.totpHint: Enter the {{length}}-digit code from your authenticator app.
deletion.submitApple: Confirm with Apple and delete my account
deletion.submitQuestion: Your account will be closed now and deleted permanently after {{days}} days. Are you sure?
deletion.doneMessage: We received your deletion request. Your account will be deleted permanently in {{days}} days.
deletion.doneMessageUntil: We received your deletion request. Your account will be deleted permanently on {{date}}.
deletion.doneCancel: If you change your mind, sign in again before the {{days}} days are over; the deletion is cancelled.
deletion.doneEmail: A confirmation is sent to your email address when the deletion is complete.

errors.reauth_required: Your password or identity check was not accepted. Check it and try again.
errors.step_up_required: The verification code is missing or wrong. Enter the current code from your app.
errors.deletion_pending: A deletion request for this account has already been received.
errors.last_admin: The last admin account cannot be deleted. Appoint another admin first.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.

deletion.noRequest: No account deletion was requested on this device. Taking you to your profile.
